qualification_this_checkpoint.foreign_boundary_qualification: Current native/JS bindings do not expose these glTF functions; wasm32 compile/Clippy checked. Actual Node Khronos validator consumes generated JSON/GLB files; this is format validation, not binding acceptance.

independent_semantics.empty: Schema-valid empty scene, named empty node, JSON-only GLB; canonical empty import -> transform -> strict regularized-set identities -> export/import, union and complete repeated subtraction.
independent_semantics.full_scale: The unchanged 10000-node valid hierarchy completes. The baseline aborts with stack overflow; the independent Khronos validator also overflows on this fixture. No reduced fixture replaces it.
independent_semantics.malformed: Zero counts, missing references, wrong index type, unreadable ranges, alignment/overflow, sparse order/count/bounds, cycles/multiple parents/non-root scene nodes, present empty arrays and invalid transforms return errors. Invalid native geometry and duplicate names cannot become successful empty output.
independent_semantics.nonempty: Exact box boundary planes and signed volume, separately checked for each disconnected component before Booleans; strict PWN/manifold checks. Native TRIANGLES index order and exact integer positions checked across 24 unsigned/implicit/interleaved/sparse JSON and GLB combinations.
independent_semantics.provenance: Approximate hull -> strict full subtraction -> export -> import -> transform/strict Boolean -> export/import. Import reports missing source history, and subsequent local certification does not erase it. Empty import consumes no coordinates and does not add a projection flag. The format does not preserve the original construction receipt.

intermediate_library_replacement.reason: Cargo uses an unqualified libcsgrs.rlib path across feature configurations. Read-only final audit found that the legitimate default-feature checks replaced this intermediate after frozen probes were compiled and executed. Rebuild the original configuration under identical production pins and retain exact library copies. No source or test change.

qualification_this_checkpoint.next: Repair reproduced PLY tiny-coordinate loss, then classify scalar-adapter index projection and remaining native format failures. Continue strict completion, provenance and current source-package/public release validation. Hypervoxel remains out of scope.
qualification_this_checkpoint.owner: CSGRS glTF format boundary; native triangle carriers, gltf parser/document validation and shared scalar/mesh implementations retained.
qualification_this_checkpoint.parser_bridge: The gltf-json dependency requires Scene.nodes although glTF permits omission. Normalize that one optional property internally, reject explicitly empty node arrays, then reuse its typed Root and native document validation. Prevalidate accessor references before its unchecked POSITION hook and consumed byte ranges before its readers. No replacement geometry kernel.
